region: Suyian Ranch (43,000 acres), central Kenya / northwest Laikipia, near Loisaba Conservancy
tier: Contract 30% Nett (Rate shown alongside; verified Rate x 0.70, e.g. 5204/7435=0.70)
unit: Fully inclusive private camp - whole-camp exclusive use, tiered by guest count

source.file: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/THE SAFARI COLLECTION/SIRUAI MOBILE CAMP 2026 30% RATES 09.05.25.pdf

operatingSeason: Camp is seasonal - open approximately June to mid-October and mid-December to mid-January only (mobile camp, weather-dependent, can be reopened if needed).

professionalGuideRoom.unit: per person per night, exclusive of conservation fees

inclusions: All meals and drinks (house wines/soft drinks/beers/spirits)
Game drives, hiking, fishing, kayaking, other camp activities
Private guide and vehicles (1 car + 1 guide per 5 guests)

childPolicy.definition: 3 years - 15 years 364 days; 16+ is adult; infants (0-2y364d) free
childPolicy.note: Welcomes children of all ages; one tent near the mess area can accommodate up to 3 children. No fences - parents must watch young children in this wild open setting.

access.byAir: Scheduled Safarilink/AirKenya to Loisaba Conservancy (~45 min road to camp); charter to Suyian Airstrip (10 min to camp).

bookingPolicy.exclusiveUse: Whole-camp exclusive use per group, first-confirmation basis.
bookingPolicy.payment: Full balance due 45 days before arrival.

cancellationPolicy.charge: 20% deposit refunded net of bank/admin fees (5% of booking value)
